---
title: "Lecture 15: Convolutional Neural Networks"
---

## Overview

Convolution reuses a small detector across an image. We compute its response, distinguish equivariance from invariance, and test how architecture and shifted training affect predictions on the same handwritten digits.

## Learning Objectives

- Calculate a filter response and explain local connectivity and weight sharing.
- Identify what pooling preserves and what it discards.
- Evaluate shift robustness and interpret feature maps and sensitivity probes carefully.
